the neutrino data can be well accommodated in the low-energy Higss triplet model with a light doubly charged Higgs and that the model can be tested by the future lepton flavor violating experiments as well as the future collider experiments such as ILC, LHC and CLIC.

a doubly charged Higg boson can be discovered at the LHC if it is heavier than about 200GeV, and the neutrino oscillation experiments can be sensitive enough to determine neutrino mass patterns if the doubly charged Higgs is light enough.
the low-energy Higg triplet model can be tested at the future lepton colliders, such as ILC or CEPC, with a sensitivity to a few TeV.
